title: event.subEvent.capacity
description:
The capacity of this occurrence: whether the number of places is limited, and how many places are taken. Only supported on events with calendarType `single` or `multiple`.

When a subEvent has no `capacity`, its capacity is unknown. Send an empty object (`{}`) to clear the capacity and make it unknown again.

Capacity is commercially sensitive. It is only returned by `GET /events/{eventId}` when you add `embedCapacities=true` and are allowed to edit the event. It is never available through the Search API.

type.description:
Required, unless `capacity` is an empty object.

- `Limited`: There is a maximum number of places, given in `maximum`.
- `Unlimited`: There is deliberately no maximum number of places.

maximum.description: The maximum number of places. Required when `type` is `Limited`, not allowed when `type` is `Unlimited`.

taken.description: The number of places that are booked, as an absolute number. Optional for both types. Can be higher than `maximum`, because overbooking happens.
